title: HealthLog – Overview
description: Daily health snapshot: last night's sleep, HRV & resting heart rate, stress score and Body Battery, mood (State of Mind), heart rate alerts and ECGs, sleep trends, overnight vitals, activity, body weight, and the nightly analysis' findings. Stress and Body Battery are derived proxies calibrated to your own baseline, not Garmin-comparable values. Days, bedtime and wake-up hours follow the configured TZ (hidden 'tz' variable, read from the database); times are displayed in your browser's timezone (Settings → Timezone to override). Time window: 30 days.

panels.title: Last Night – Total Sleep
panels.description: Total sleep duration for the most recent night. Yellow ≥ 6 h, green ≥ 7 h (WHO recommendation).

targets.rawSql: SELECT (sleep_date::timestamp AT TIME ZONE '$tz') AS time, total_sleep_h AS "Total Sleep" FROM sleep_nightly WHERE $__timeFilter((sleep_date::timestamp AT TIME ZONE '$tz')) ORDER BY sleep_date

panels.title: Last Night – Sleep Efficiency
panels.description: % of time in bed actually asleep. Calculated from in-bed timestamps when available, otherwise total_sleep / (sleep + awake). Yellow ≥ 75 %, green ≥ 85 %.

targets.rawSql: SELECT (sleep_date::timestamp AT TIME ZONE '$tz') AS time, ROUND(efficiency_pct::numeric, 0) AS "Sleep Efficiency" FROM sleep_metrics WHERE $__timeFilter((sleep_date::timestamp AT TIME ZONE '$tz')) ORDER BY sleep_date

panels.title: Today – HRV
panels.description: Latest daily HRV average (ms). Higher = better autonomic recovery. Yellow ≥ 30 ms, green ≥ 50 ms.

targets.rawSql: SELECT (day::timestamp AT TIME ZONE '$tz') AS time, avg AS "HRV" FROM daily_metrics WHERE metric = 'heart_rate_variability' AND $__timeFilter((day::timestamp AT TIME ZONE '$tz')) ORDER BY day

panels.title: Today – Resting HR
panels.description: Latest daily resting heart rate minimum (bpm). Lower = better cardiovascular fitness. Yellow ≥ 65 bpm, red ≥ 75 bpm.

targets.rawSql: SELECT (day::timestamp AT TIME ZONE '$tz') AS time, vmin AS "Resting HR" FROM daily_metrics WHERE metric = 'resting_heart_rate' AND $__timeFilter((day::timestamp AT TIME ZONE '$tz')) ORDER BY day

panels.title: Stress Score — latest day
panels.description: Overall daily stress (0-100), most recent day in range. A derived proxy from the heart-rate elevation above your resting baseline (workouts excluded), HRV-calibrated — NOT a Garmin value. Blue rest < 25, green low < 50, orange medium < 75, red high.

targets.rawSql: SELECT (day::timestamp AT TIME ZONE '$tz') AS time, score AS "Stress Score" FROM stress_daily WHERE $__timeFilter((day::timestamp AT TIME ZONE '$tz')) ORDER BY day

panels.title: Body Battery — current reserve
panels.description: Latest energy reserve (0-100) in range: the stress timeline integrated against recovery — stress and workouts drain it, calm rest and sleep charge it. A proxy on the stress proxy (no RR intervals), relative to your own baseline, NOT a Garmin value. Red near-empty < 20, orange < 50, green charged.

targets.rawSql: SELECT ts AS "time", level AS "Body Battery" FROM body_battery_intraday WHERE $__timeFilter(ts) AND level IS NOT NULL ORDER BY ts

panels.title: Avg Total Sleep (7d)
panels.description: Average total sleep duration over the last 7 nights. Yellow ≥ 6 h, green ≥ 7 h.

targets.rawSql: SELECT ROUND(AVG(total_sleep_h)::numeric, 1) AS "Avg Total Sleep" FROM sleep_nightly WHERE sleep_date >= (NOW() AT TIME ZONE '$tz')::date - 7

panels.title: Avg Deep Sleep (7d)
panels.description: Average deep (slow-wave) sleep over the last 7 nights. Yellow ≥ 0.8 h, green ≥ 1.2 h.

targets.rawSql: SELECT ROUND(AVG(deep_h)::numeric, 1) AS "Avg Deep Sleep" FROM sleep_nightly WHERE sleep_date >= (NOW() AT TIME ZONE '$tz')::date - 7

panels.title: Avg REM Sleep (7d)
panels.description: Average REM sleep over the last 7 nights. Yellow ≥ 1.0 h, green ≥ 1.5 h.

targets.rawSql: SELECT ROUND(AVG(rem_h)::numeric, 1) AS "Avg REM Sleep" FROM sleep_nightly WHERE sleep_date >= (NOW() AT TIME ZONE '$tz')::date - 7

panels.title: Avg Sleep Efficiency (7d)
panels.description: Average sleep efficiency over the last 7 nights. Calculated from in-bed timestamps when available, otherwise total_sleep / (sleep + awake). Yellow ≥ 75 %, green ≥ 85 %.

targets.rawSql: SELECT ROUND(AVG(efficiency_pct)::numeric, 0) AS "Avg Sleep Efficiency" FROM sleep_metrics WHERE sleep_date >= (NOW() AT TIME ZONE '$tz')::date - 7

panels.title: Sleep Phases
panels.description: Stacked hours per phase for each night (Deep + Core + REM + Awake). Total bar height is time asleep plus awake-in-bed; the Awake segment on top shows fragmentation. Hover for the per-phase breakdown.

targets.rawSql: SELECT (sleep_date::timestamp AT TIME ZONE '$tz') AS time, deep_h AS "Deep", core_h AS "Core", rem_h AS "REM", awake_h AS "Awake" FROM sleep_nightly WHERE $__timeFilter((sleep_date::timestamp AT TIME ZONE '$tz')) ORDER BY sleep_date

panels.title: Sleep Duration
panels.description: Total sleep per night. Dashed line is the 7-day moving average.

targets.rawSql: SELECT (sleep_date::timestamp AT TIME ZONE '$tz') AS time, total_sleep_h AS "Total Sleep (h)" FROM sleep_nightly WHERE $__timeFilter((sleep_date::timestamp AT TIME ZONE '$tz')) ORDER BY sleep_date

SELECT (sleep_date::timestamp AT TIME ZONE '$tz') AS time, ROUND(AVG(total_sleep_h) OVER (ORDER BY sleep_date ROWS BETWEEN 6 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW)::numeric, 2) AS "7d Trend (h)" FROM sleep_nightly WHERE $__timeFilter((sleep_date::timestamp AT TIME ZONE '$tz')) ORDER BY sleep_date

panels.title: Sleep Efficiency
panels.description: % of time in bed actually asleep. Calculated from in-bed timestamps when available, otherwise total_sleep / (sleep + awake). Dashed line is the 7-day moving average.

targets.rawSql: SELECT (sleep_date::timestamp AT TIME ZONE '$tz') AS time, efficiency_pct AS "Sleep Efficiency (%)" FROM sleep_metrics WHERE $__timeFilter((sleep_date::timestamp AT TIME ZONE '$tz')) ORDER BY sleep_date

SELECT (sleep_date::timestamp AT TIME ZONE '$tz') AS time, ROUND(AVG(efficiency_pct) OVER (ORDER BY sleep_date ROWS BETWEEN 6 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW)::numeric, 1) AS "7d Trend (%)" FROM sleep_metrics WHERE $__timeFilter((sleep_date::timestamp AT TIME ZONE '$tz')) ORDER BY sleep_date

panels.title: Bedtime
panels.description: Hour of sleep onset on a 20–30 scale (20 = 20:00, 24 = midnight, 26 = 02:00 next day). Uses the configured TZ. Dashed line is the 7-day moving average.

targets.rawSql: SELECT (sleep_date::timestamp AT TIME ZONE '$tz') AS time, EXTRACT(HOUR FROM (sleep_start AT TIME ZONE '$tz')) + EXTRACT(MINUTE FROM (sleep_start AT TIME ZONE '$tz'))/60.0 + CASE WHEN EXTRACT(HOUR FROM (sleep_start AT TIME ZONE '$tz')) < 12 THEN 24 ELSE 0 END AS "Bedtime (h)" FROM sleep_nightly WHERE $__timeFilter((sleep_date::timestamp AT TIME ZONE '$tz')) AND sleep_start IS NOT NULL ORDER BY sleep_date

SELECT (sleep_date::timestamp AT TIME ZONE '$tz') AS time, ROUND(AVG(EXTRACT(HOUR FROM (sleep_start AT TIME ZONE '$tz')) + EXTRACT(MINUTE FROM (sleep_start AT TIME ZONE '$tz'))/60.0 + CASE WHEN EXTRACT(HOUR FROM (sleep_start AT TIME ZONE '$tz')) < 12 THEN 24 ELSE 0 END) OVER (ORDER BY sleep_date ROWS BETWEEN 6 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW)::numeric, 2) AS "7d Trend (h)" FROM sleep_nightly WHERE $__timeFilter((sleep_date::timestamp AT TIME ZONE '$tz')) AND sleep_start IS NOT NULL ORDER BY sleep_date

panels.title: Wake-up Time
panels.description: Hour of wake-up in the configured TZ. Dashed line is the 7-day moving average.

targets.rawSql: SELECT (sleep_date::timestamp AT TIME ZONE '$tz') AS time, EXTRACT(HOUR FROM (sleep_end AT TIME ZONE '$tz')) + EXTRACT(MINUTE FROM (sleep_end AT TIME ZONE '$tz'))/60.0 AS "Wake-up (h)" FROM sleep_nightly WHERE $__timeFilter((sleep_date::timestamp AT TIME ZONE '$tz')) AND sleep_end IS NOT NULL ORDER BY sleep_date

SELECT (sleep_date::timestamp AT TIME ZONE '$tz') AS time, ROUND(AVG(EXTRACT(HOUR FROM (sleep_end AT TIME ZONE '$tz')) + EXTRACT(MINUTE FROM (sleep_end AT TIME ZONE '$tz'))/60.0) OVER (ORDER BY sleep_date ROWS BETWEEN 6 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW)::numeric, 2) AS "7d Trend (h)" FROM sleep_nightly WHERE $__timeFilter((sleep_date::timestamp AT TIME ZONE '$tz')) AND sleep_end IS NOT NULL ORDER BY sleep_date

panels.title: Respiratory Rate & Wrist Temperature
panels.description: Overnight recovery markers. Respiratory rate (left axis, breaths/min): a stable baseline is normal; sustained elevation can precede illness or follow hard training. Wrist temperature (right axis, °C) is shown as the deviation around your own baseline, not an absolute body temperature. Dashed lines are 7-day moving averages.

targets.rawSql: SELECT (day::timestamp AT TIME ZONE '$tz') AS time, avg AS "Resp Rate (/min)" FROM daily_metrics WHERE metric = 'respiratory_rate' AND $__timeFilter((day::timestamp AT TIME ZONE '$tz')) ORDER BY day

SELECT (day::timestamp AT TIME ZONE '$tz') AS time, ROUND(avg::numeric, 2) AS "Wrist Temp (°C)" FROM daily_metrics WHERE metric = 'apple_sleeping_wrist_temperature' AND $__timeFilter((day::timestamp AT TIME ZONE '$tz')) ORDER BY day

SELECT (day::timestamp AT TIME ZONE '$tz') AS time, ROUND(AVG(avg) OVER (ORDER BY day ROWS BETWEEN 6 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW)::numeric, 1) AS "Resp Rate Trend (/min)" FROM daily_metrics WHERE metric = 'respiratory_rate' AND $__timeFilter((day::timestamp AT TIME ZONE '$tz')) ORDER BY day

SELECT (day::timestamp AT TIME ZONE '$tz') AS time, ROUND(AVG(avg) OVER (ORDER BY day ROWS BETWEEN 6 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW)::numeric, 2) AS "Wrist Temp Trend (°C)" FROM daily_metrics WHERE metric = 'apple_sleeping_wrist_temperature' AND $__timeFilter((day::timestamp AT TIME ZONE '$tz')) ORDER BY day

panels.title: Blood Oxygen Saturation (SpO₂)
panels.description: Overnight blood oxygen saturation (%). Typical healthy range is ~95–100 %; brief dips can occur normally. Persistently low overnight values may warrant attention. Dashed line is the 7-day moving average.

targets.rawSql: SELECT (day::timestamp AT TIME ZONE '$tz') AS time, ROUND(avg::numeric, 1) AS "SpO₂ (%)" FROM daily_metrics WHERE metric = 'blood_oxygen_saturation' AND $__timeFilter((day::timestamp AT TIME ZONE '$tz')) ORDER BY day

SELECT (day::timestamp AT TIME ZONE '$tz') AS time, ROUND(AVG(avg) OVER (ORDER BY day ROWS BETWEEN 6 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW)::numeric, 1) AS "7d Trend (%)" FROM daily_metrics WHERE metric = 'blood_oxygen_saturation' AND $__timeFilter((day::timestamp AT TIME ZONE '$tz')) ORDER BY day

panels.title: Breathing Disturbances (count / night)
panels.description: Nightly breathing-disturbance count from the Apple Watch (the sleep-apnoea indicator, watchOS 11+). Shows data only when the watch records it and HAE exports the breathing_disturbances metric.

targets.rawSql: SELECT (day::timestamp AT TIME ZONE '$tz') AS time, sum AS "Disturbances" FROM daily_metrics WHERE metric = 'breathing_disturbances' AND $__timeFilter((day::timestamp AT TIME ZONE '$tz')) ORDER BY day

panels.title: Time in stress zones (per day)
panels.description: Minutes per day in each stress zone, plus workout (Active) minutes. Stacked bars.

targets.rawSql: SELECT (day::timestamp AT TIME ZONE '$tz') AS time, rest_min AS "Rest", low_min AS "Low", medium_min AS "Medium", high_min AS "High", active_min AS "Active" FROM stress_daily WHERE $__timeFilter((day::timestamp AT TIME ZONE '$tz')) ORDER BY day

panels.title: Daily stress score — trend
panels.description: Overall daily stress score over time. Interpret relative to your own baseline, not Garmin.

targets.rawSql: SELECT (day::timestamp AT TIME ZONE '$tz') AS time, score AS "Stress Score" FROM stress_daily WHERE $__timeFilter((day::timestamp AT TIME ZONE '$tz')) ORDER BY day

panels.title: Intraday stress timeline
panels.description: Per-bucket stress (0-100) over the selected range, coloured by zone. Gaps are unmeasured (watch off / workout). For a usable timeline set Health Auto Export's Time Grouping to Minute.

targets.rawSql: SELECT ts AS "time", stress AS "Stress" FROM stress_intraday WHERE $__timeFilter(ts) AND stress IS NOT NULL ORDER BY ts

panels.title: Intraday Body Battery timeline
panels.description: Per-bucket energy reserve (0-100) over the selected range. Rises during calm rest and sleep, falls with stress and workouts. For a usable timeline set Health Auto Export's Time Grouping to Minute.

targets.rawSql: SELECT ts AS "time", level AS "Body Battery" FROM body_battery_intraday WHERE $__timeFilter(ts) AND level IS NOT NULL ORDER BY ts

panels.title: Body Battery — daily wake / high / low
panels.description: Per day: the level you woke with (end of main sleep), the day's peak and trough. Wake and high near 100 = well recharged; a low trough = the tank ran empty.

targets.rawSql: SELECT (day::timestamp AT TIME ZONE '$tz') AS time, wake_level AS "Wake", high_level AS "High", low_level AS "Low" FROM body_battery_daily WHERE $__timeFilter((day::timestamp AT TIME ZONE '$tz')) ORDER BY day

panels.title: Charged vs drained (per day)
panels.description: Total points the battery gained (charged) and lost (drained) each day. Charged should outweigh drained on a well-recovered day.

targets.rawSql: SELECT (day::timestamp AT TIME ZONE '$tz') AS time, charged AS "Charged", drained AS "Drained" FROM body_battery_daily WHERE $__timeFilter((day::timestamp AT TIME ZONE '$tz')) ORDER BY day

panels.title: Mood — valence
panels.description: Apple Health State of Mind (logged on the iPhone or Watch, exported by Health Auto Export). Valence runs from -1 (very unpleasant) to +1 (very pleasant). The line is the daily mean of all entries (days in the configured TZ); the points are the individual daily moods and momentary emotions. Descriptive only: the nightly analysis does not use mood data yet.

targets.rawSql: SELECT (day::timestamp AT TIME ZONE '$tz') AS time, ROUND(AVG(valence)::numeric, 2) AS "Daily mean" FROM (SELECT (start_time AT TIME ZONE '$tz')::date AS day, valence FROM state_of_mind WHERE valence IS NOT NULL AND $__timeFilter(start_time)) s GROUP BY day ORDER BY day
SELECT start_time AS "time", valence AS "Daily mood" FROM state_of_mind WHERE kind = 'daily_mood' AND valence IS NOT NULL AND $__timeFilter(start_time) ORDER BY start_time
SELECT start_time AS "time", valence AS "Momentary emotion" FROM state_of_mind WHERE kind = 'momentary_emotion' AND valence IS NOT NULL AND $__timeFilter(start_time) ORDER BY start_time

panels.title: Most frequent feelings
panels.description: How often each feeling label (Apple's vocabulary, e.g. Calm, Stressed) was logged in the selected range; top 15.

targets.rawSql: SELECT INITCAP(REPLACE(v, '_', ' ')) AS "Feeling", COUNT(*) AS "Entries" FROM state_of_mind, UNNEST(labels) AS v WHERE $__timeFilter(start_time) GROUP BY v ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC, v LIMIT 15

panels.title: Most frequent life areas
panels.description: How often each life area (Apple's associations, e.g. Work, Family) was attached to an entry in the selected range; top 15.

targets.rawSql: SELECT INITCAP(REPLACE(v, '_', ' ')) AS "Life area", COUNT(*) AS "Entries" FROM state_of_mind, UNNEST(associations) AS v WHERE $__timeFilter(start_time) GROUP BY v ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC, v LIMIT 15

panels.title: Heart rate notifications
panels.description: Apple Watch high, low and irregular rhythm alerts (exported by Health Auto Export). Threshold is the alert's configured limit; min / avg / max summarise the heart-rate readings behind the alert. Descriptive only: the nightly analysis does not use these yet.

targets.rawSql: SELECT start_time AS "Time", INITCAP(REPLACE(REPLACE(kind, '_notification', ''), '_', ' ')) AS "Alert", threshold AS "Threshold", hr_min AS "Min", ROUND(hr_avg::numeric, 1) AS "Avg", hr_max AS "Max" FROM heart_rate_notifications WHERE $__timeFilter(start_time) ORDER BY start_time DESC

panels.title: ECG recordings
panels.description: Apple Watch ECG recordings: the watch's classification and the average heart rate during the 30-second recording. Only a summary is stored, never the waveform. An inconclusive recording has no average heart rate.

targets.rawSql: SELECT start_time AS "Time", classification AS "Result", average_heart_rate AS "Avg heart rate" FROM ecg_recordings WHERE $__timeFilter(start_time) ORDER BY start_time DESC

panels.title: Daily Steps
panels.description: Total step count per day (sum of all intraday samples). A common general-health target is ~10,000 steps/day.

targets.rawSql: SELECT (day::timestamp AT TIME ZONE '$tz') AS time, sum AS "Steps" FROM daily_metrics WHERE metric = 'step_count' AND $__timeFilter((day::timestamp AT TIME ZONE '$tz')) ORDER BY day

panels.title: Active Energy
panels.description: Active energy burned per day (kcal) — movement on top of basal metabolism. Sum of all intraday samples.

targets.rawSql: SELECT (day::timestamp AT TIME ZONE '$tz') AS time, sum AS "Active Energy (kcal)" FROM daily_metrics WHERE metric = 'active_energy' AND $__timeFilter((day::timestamp AT TIME ZONE '$tz')) ORDER BY day

panels.title: Exercise Minutes
panels.description: Apple exercise-ring minutes per day (apple_exercise_time, sum of all intraday samples). The Apple default goal is 30 min/day.

targets.rawSql: SELECT (day::timestamp AT TIME ZONE '$tz') AS time, sum AS "Exercise (min)" FROM daily_metrics WHERE metric = 'apple_exercise_time' AND $__timeFilter((day::timestamp AT TIME ZONE '$tz')) ORDER BY day

panels.title: Walking / Running Distance (km)
panels.description: Daily walking + running distance (walking_running_distance, sum of all intraday samples) — everyday movement, not just workouts.

targets.rawSql: SELECT (day::timestamp AT TIME ZONE '$tz') AS time, ROUND(sum::numeric, 1) AS "Distance (km)" FROM daily_metrics WHERE metric = 'walking_running_distance' AND $__timeFilter((day::timestamp AT TIME ZONE '$tz')) ORDER BY day

panels.title: Latest Weight
panels.description: Most recent body-mass reading within the selected time range (daily average when the scale reports several).

targets.rawSql: SELECT (day::timestamp AT TIME ZONE '$tz') AS time, ROUND(avg::numeric, 1) AS "Weight" FROM daily_metrics WHERE metric = 'weight_body_mass' AND $__timeFilter((day::timestamp AT TIME ZONE '$tz')) ORDER BY day

panels.title: Weight Trend
panels.description: Daily body mass (average of the day's readings). Sparse by nature — points appear only on days with a measurement. Dashed line is the moving average of the last 7 measurement days.

targets.rawSql: SELECT (day::timestamp AT TIME ZONE '$tz') AS time, ROUND(avg::numeric, 1) AS "Weight" FROM daily_metrics WHERE metric = 'weight_body_mass' AND $__timeFilter((day::timestamp AT TIME ZONE '$tz')) ORDER BY day

SELECT (day::timestamp AT TIME ZONE '$tz') AS time, ROUND(AVG(avg) OVER (ORDER BY day ROWS BETWEEN 6 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW)::numeric, 1) AS "Trend (kg)" FROM daily_metrics WHERE metric = 'weight_body_mass' AND $__timeFilter((day::timestamp AT TIME ZONE '$tz')) ORDER BY day

panels.title: Recent Findings
panels.description: Latest findings of every kind from the nightly analysis (anomalies, recovery alerts, training load, consistency, ...). Correlations are excluded here - they have their own panel below.

targets.rawSql: SELECT TO_CHAR(day, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS "Date", kind AS "Kind", metric_a AS "Metric", detail AS "Detail", note AS "Note" FROM findings_feed WHERE kind <> 'correlation' ORDER BY day DESC LIMIT 50

panels.title: Top Correlations
panels.description: Lagged Spearman relationships between metrics, ranked by report_priority (analysis.py): cross-domain links (e.g. training load → next-day respiratory rate) rank above expected within-subsystem pairs (total vs deep sleep, average vs resting HR). The Priority column reflects the stored details.priority_tier; r is the de-trended coefficient, lag the strongest lead/lag.

targets.rawSql: SELECT COALESCE(ra.display_name, f.metric_a) || ' → ' || COALESCE(rb.display_name, f.metric_b) AS "Relationship", CASE WHEN COALESCE(f.lag_days,0) = 0 THEN 'same day' ELSE f.lag_days::text || 'd lag' END AS "Lag", ROUND(f.coefficient::numeric, 2) AS "r", CASE COALESCE((f.details->>'priority_tier')::int, 1) WHEN 2 THEN 'cross-domain' WHEN 0 THEN 'expected' ELSE 'neutral' END AS "Priority" FROM findings f LEFT JOIN metric_registry ra ON ra.metric = f.metric_a LEFT JOIN metric_registry rb ON rb.metric = f.metric_b WHERE f.kind = 'correlation' ORDER BY COALESCE((f.details->>'priority_tier')::int, 1) DESC, ABS(f.coefficient) DESC LIMIT 30

list.name: tz
list.label: Timezone
list.description: Hidden. The configured TZ, read from app_settings.local_tz (written from the TZ environment variable at container start). Daily panels return each day's local midnight in this zone (so bars land on the right date whatever the dashboard timezone is), and it drives the SQL-side local-date / clock-hour math.
list.query: SELECT value FROM app_settings WHERE key = 'local_tz'
list.definition: SELECT value FROM app_settings WHERE key = 'local_tz'
